reply.text:
One all-nighter won't undo your training, but a heavy day on zero sleep is a poor trade. Your coordination, focus and effort are all down, so the heavy lifts are the ones I'd back off.

If you're going to go, keep it lighter than planned: shorter, leave a few more reps in the tank than usual, and skip any max attempts. An easy walk or an easy run also counts. If you feel wrecked once you're warmed up, cut it short and call it done.

Tonight, get a real night's sleep and hit your normal session tomorrow. Want me to move today's session so it lands on a better day?
